title: rp.id / rpId getters return rp-a.test on the first read and rp-b.test afterwards

unsafe.definition: a credential or assertion for rp-b.test, or a SecurityError path that still stored a passkey

note: WebIDL dictionary conversion reads each member once when the method is called; L3 then works on the converted copy, so the RP ID is rp-a.test. A provider that re-reads the live object sees rp-b.test.
